newsitem.title: CHINA: Fan new head of China-backed HK provisional body.
newsitem.headline: Fan new head of China-backed HK provisional body.

text.p: A controversial Beijing-backed provisional legislature, set up to make laws in Hong Kong after its reversion to China this year, elected politician Rita Fan as its president on Saturday.

Fan polled 33 votes in the first meeting of the 60-member body in the Chinese city of Shenzhen. Her only rival Andrew Wong, incumbent president of Hong Kong's current elected Legislative Council, got 27.

The meeting, observed by journalists through closed circuit television, took place amid a rift between China and Britain, the outgoing colonial power, over Bejing's plans to roll back civil liberties in Hong Kong after the handover on July 1.
